Resolves #19713

`neuralLink.connectToApp` never binds by app name any more. The old identity read passed an async predicate to `page.waitForFunction`. Its Promise is truthy, so the wait returned the first read (null while the worker booted), and the call then bound by name, which `waitForSession` resolves to the oldest same-name session. Now:
- Given a name, `connectToApp` binds the page's own App Worker. The new exported `readWorkerId` polls for that id through `expect.poll`, bounded by `identityTimeout` (default 30 s), and the call fails if no id arrives.
- Given an App Worker id, `connectToApp` binds it as given. `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` relies on this: it reads an id from a page in a fresh context after closing the fixture's.

Evidence: L3 (real browser against a real Bridge, local: head green; mutation red on both new arms) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2 are runtime fixture behavior). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #19655.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs run in CI.

## Deltas from ticket
The ticket's first draft kept the name fallback for pages without Neo. Neither that nor its replacement survived: see Evolution.

## Test Evidence
Local runs with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set and a private Bridge on `NEO_NL_PORT=8191`:
- Head `b0a0edc2fc`: `Fixture.spec.mjs` and `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs`, 12 passed (50.6 s).
- Mutation at `087ae843a9`: `connectToApp`'s old identity read restored, specs unchanged. Run twice, 2 failed and 1 passed each time. The competitor test bound the older session (`expect(app.sessionId).not.toBe(olderId)` failed, received the older id). The refusal test hung until the 90 s test timeout, which is the old unbounded Neo wait on an open page.
- Playwright 1.63.0 probe, page value set after 1500 ms: the async predicate returned `null` after 9 ms; the same predicate written sync returned the value after 1492 ms.

The local Brain checkout trails Brain `dev` by 44 commits. The Neural Link changes since then settle lost calls (Brain #1004); they do not change session matching. CI runs against the `dev` tip.

- [ ] The next `dev` runs' retry lists show whether FiveBeat scene 2 (morph) still needs the retry. It needed it in #19705's run and in 38403855169. The result goes on #19655.

## Commits
- `087ae843a9`: the polled id, the refusal and the two new tests.
- `b0a0edc2fc`: an explicit worker id binds as given.

## Evolution
`087ae843a9` deleted the argument fallback outright. I claimed nothing reached it, because on an open page without Neo the old wait hung until the test timeout. On a closed page it threw at once and fell back to the argument instead, and `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` :290 and :333 pass an exact worker id after closing the fixture's context. CI shard 9 went red on both attempts ([run 38411777624](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38411777624)), and the step hit its 5-minute ceiling. `b0a0edc2fc` honors an exact id, and the competitor test now pins that arm too.

Related: #19655 · #19711 (its local `readWorkerId` copy can switch to the export)
